name: Kittens and Barbells Rescue, Inc.
notes: Foster-based 501(c)(3) cat rescue for New York City and Westchester, taking the most vulnerable cats: newborn kittens through seniors, including sick and injured cats, plus trap-neuter-return and a hospice-foster programme. Its contact page says it gets more requests than it has foster homes for and may take up to 72 hours to answer email; in an emergency, go to your local shelter.
